name: Workflow with AI (sales review)
welcome: Good morning! I'm your sales review workflow. Start a daily review when you're ready.
description: Fixed steps, with an AI step that writes part of the reply.

name: Pure workflow (no AI)
welcome: Good morning! I'm the pure sales review workflow. Start a daily review when you're ready.
description: Fixed steps only, with no AI step.

name: Eve agent (AI with tools)
welcome: Hi, I'm the Eve sales review agent. Ask me to run a daily review, for example: Run the daily review for 2026-06-29.
description: Eve agent. An AI model chooses the tools.

name: Non AI Eve WooCommerce Analyst
welcome: Pick a date and run the daily sales review. No AI is used.
description: Eve workflow with code steps. No model calls.

name: Eve Data Analyst
welcome: Hi, I'm the Eve data analyst. Ask me a question about the business, for example: How many paying customers do we have today?
description: Eve data analyst. Answers business questions from the warehouse.

name: Eve Woo AI Analyst
welcome: Hi, I'm the Eve Woo AI Analyst. Ask me about sales, orders, products, customers, or coupons, for example: How many orders are pending?
description: WooCommerce store reports. Answers from read-only report tools.

name: Woo Analyst AI Chat
welcome: Hi, I'm the Woo Analyst AI Chat. Ask me about sales, orders, products, customers, or coupons, for example: How many orders are pending?
description: Pure AI chat with the WooCommerce report tools. Answers from the store data.

name: Local AI Woo Analyst
welcome: Hi, I'm the Local AI Woo Analyst. Ask me about sales, orders, products, customers, or coupons, for example: How many orders are pending?
description: Local model test. Same report tools as the Woo Analyst AI Chat.

name: Eve combrain agent
welcome: Hi, I'm the Eve combrain agent. Ask me anything about the company.
description: Company brain agent with private memory.
